text:
RemoteAwaitPolicy gains maximumPollInterval and accountingEveryPolls (both defaulted, so existing two-argument construction still compiles). intervalAfter(attempt) doubles from pollInterval to the ceiling with overflow-safe arithmetic; checksAccounting(attempt) runs accounting on the first poll and then every Nth. Both poll loops (RemoteTaskHandle and RemoteScriptBatchElementHandle) thread the attempt counter and use them; both validators now also require maximumPollInterval >= pollInterval.

Defaults moved from 1 s fixed / accounting every poll to 5 s initial, 60 s ceiling, accounting every 6 polls. A full day of waiting drops from 86,400 result reads + 86,400 sacct queries to about 1,443 and 241.

Evidence: new RemoteAwaitPolicySuite (6 tests) covers the backoff sequence, ceiling clamping at Long.MaxValue, the accounting cadence, a replay of the loop arithmetic over a 24 h budget, an explicit opt-in to an aggressive cadence, and a ceiling below the initial interval never shortening the caller's interval. ssh 29/29. Documented in docs/examples/typed-task.md.
